messages:
Maya (CS): heads up — VeridianHealth wants a concise SLO/SLA packet for onboarding review on Tues. They specifically asked for uptime calc, 95th latency, and how credits would be applied.
Jin (CS Ops): got it. do we have their traffic shape and peak windows? need that for the 95th latency context.
Sophie (Acct Exec): they run bulk ingestion 02:00-04:00 PT daily, steady during business hours, spikes end of month. I can share sampling from their onboarding telemetry.
Jin (CS Ops): perfect. share a csv and i'll run the raw percentile calc. also want to confirm the SLO buckets: 99.9% monthly uptime and 95th <= 350ms for text-gen endpoints — is that still what we promised?
Maya (CS): yes that's the baseline in their onboarding MOU. we should also include an example credit calc and a sample email template for comms.
Arun (SRE): FYI i can pull verified metrics from prod logs. proposed query for 95th latency (Datadog):
```
avg(last_30d):p95:http.request.duration{env:prod,customer:veridianhealth} by {endpoint}
```
That gives per-endpoint 95th. For uptime:
```
100 - (sum:last_30d:errors{env:prod,customer:veridianhealth} / sum:last_30d:requests{env:prod,customer:veridianhealth} * 100)
```
Jin (CS Ops): thanks — once you drop the metrics i'll produce a simple table: window, requests, errors, uptime%, 95th latency. I'll include the raw numbers + rounded friendly values for the packet.
Sophie (Acct Exec): also want a short policy blurb so legal doesn't jump — something like: "Credits are calculated monthly, pro-rated, and applied as account credits per contract terms." Can CS draft that?
Maya (CS): yes i'll draft the blurb and the customer-facing one-paragraph summary. Jin + Arun please flag any technical caveats (e.g., maintenance windows, third-party CDN variance).
Arun (SRE): caveat: we exclude scheduled maintenance within the month if announced 72h in advance. also latency SLOs measured from our edge — if they route through an intermediate VPN we should call it out.
Jin (CS Ops): noted. i'll add a small "what this means" line in the packet: how we compute p95 and how KV/prefix caching can affect latency.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: INC-48123 — "VeridianHealth SLO evidence & credit calc" assigned to CS Ops and SRE.
Maya (CS): thanks. timeline: can we have a first draft by EOD Friday so Sophie can review before the Tue review?
Jin (CS Ops): aiming for Friday EOD. i'll drop the raw table + one sample credit calc row.
Arun (SRE): i'll attach the Datadog dashboards and a short runbook snippet for reproducing the queries.
Sophie (Acct Exec): thanks team — i’ll prep the customer invite once we have the packet. /cc @Legal for awareness. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): perfect — i'll follow up with the template and share a link here when ready.
